params.caption: 🎮 Big Walk studio admits it used generative AI "sparingly" Australian developer House House says it used generative AI sparingly while making its acclaimed multiplayer puzzle game Big Walk. The statement follows an indie award jury's stance against AI use, and puts the debate over AI in game development back in the spotlight. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 13:51 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #BigWalk #IndieGames #GamingNews
